evidence: e2m 8A44 +00 Crank_Initial_Default_Fuel (MM3S, 0.06793): cm848_calculateColdStartTempTable loads it into crank_initial_fuel when the fault bits 0x1 / 0x2 of fault_detected_bits_16_to_31 (the boost or coolant sensor errors) are set, exactly 'USED IF BOOST OR COOLANT SENSOR ERROR'; lhz; dump 1030
comment: e2m 8A44 +0 Crank_Initial_Default_Fuel (MM3S): 'CRANK INITIAL DEFAULT FUEL - USED IF BOOST OR COOLANT SENSOR ERROR'. Fallback of crank_initial_fuel in cm848_calculateColdStartTempTable while a boost or coolant sensor fault bit (0x1 / 0x2 of fault_detected_bits_16_to_31) is set, instead of the coolant temperature and pressure table. 1030 = 70.0 mm3 here

evidence: e2m 8A44 +02 Crank_Initial_Default_RPM (RPM, 1/8): cm848_calculateColdStartTempTable loads it into crank_initial_fuel_break_speed when the same sensor fault bits are set (fallback of the crank_initial_speed_values lookup), exactly 'USED IF BOOST OR COOLANT SENSOR ERROR'; lhz; dump 3600
comment: e2m 8A44 +2 Crank_Initial_Default_RPM (RPM, 1/8): 'CRANK INITIAL DEFAULT RPM - USED IF BOOST OR COOLANT SENSOR ERROR'. Fallback of crank_initial_fuel_break_speed (the initial cranking speed) in cm848_calculateColdStartTempTable while a boost or coolant sensor fault bit is set, instead of the crank_initial_speed lookup. 3600 = 450 rpm here

evidence: e2m 8A44 +04 Crank_Initial_Fuel_Max (MM3S, 0.06793): cm848_calculateColdStartFuelAdjust caps crank_adjusted_initial_fuel at it (min of this and crank_initial_fuel + crank_initial_fuel_adjustment); lhz; dump 2944
comment: e2m 8A44 +4 Crank_Initial_Fuel_Max (MM3S): 'CRANK INITIAL FUEL MAX'. Cap of crank_adjusted_initial_fuel in cm848_calculateColdStartFuelAdjust (the smaller of this and crank_initial_fuel + crank_initial_fuel_adjustment). 2944 = 200.0 mm3 here

evidence: e2m 8A44 +06 Crank_Initial_Speed_Max (RPM, 1/8): cm848_calculateColdStartFuelAdjust caps crank_adjusted_initial_rpm at it (min of this and crank_initial_fuel_break_speed + crank_initial_rpm_adjustment); lhz; dump 7600
comment: e2m 8A44 +6 Crank_Initial_Speed_Max (RPM, 1/8): 'CRANK INITIAL SPEED MAX'. Cap of crank_adjusted_initial_rpm in cm848_calculateColdStartFuelAdjust (the smaller of this and crank_initial_fuel_break_speed + crank_initial_rpm_adjustment). 7600 = 950 rpm here
